question: Mu kibiina kya P3, omusomesa alagira abayizi be okuddamu okusoma olunyiriri olumpi oluli ku lubaawo. Okusooka bakisoma kasirise, buli omu yekka, oluvannyuma bakisoma mu ddoboozi erigulumivu, nga bassaamu ekitiibwa ebiwummulo n’amaloboozi agasaanidde nga bwe biragibwa obubonero bw’empandiika. Kuyiga ki kwe kuyambibwa omulimu ogwo ogubaddewo?
answer_a: Kukulaakulanya obwangu mu kusoma
answer_b: Kukubiriza okutegeera by'osoma
answer_c: Kebera okumanya eddoboozi ly'ennimi
answer_d: Yanjula enkola z'ebikolwa ebitayogera.

question: Mu bibuuzo bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira okukozesebwa okukulaakulanya endowooza y'abayizi ku ngeri gye basoma mu kibinja nga basoma wamu mu kibiina?
answer_a: Oyinza otya okuzuula amakulu g'ebigambo by'otamanyi?
answer_b: Ekigendererwa ekikulu mu katundu ke tumaze okusoma kye ki?
answer_c: Omutwe ki gwe wandiwadde omutwe guno gwe tusoma?
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekyo kye tumaze okusoma gwe gwa ki?

question: Mu kusoma ebiwandiiko ebinnyonnyola, abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'okuna mu pulayimale balina obuzibu mu kwawulawo omutwe gw'ekigambo n'ekiteeso ekikulu. Mu nnyonnyola zino wammanga, ennyonnyola ki ennyonnyola enjawulo eno mu butuufu?
answer_a: Omutwe gw’ekigambo gwe gulinga ennyanjula y’ekyawandiiko era gukubibwawo nga tubuuza “Kiki kye twagala okwolesa mu kyawandiiko?” ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye biringana n’amalirizo g’omutwe.
answer_b: Omulamwa gwe tuteekateeka okumaliriza ku ki ekyogerwa mu mutwe, ate ebiteeso ebikulu bye bimu ku byo ebiyamba okutuuka ku malirizo ago.
answer_c: Omutwe gw'ekigambo kye kigenda okwogerwako era kizuulwa kubanga kiba mu mutwe gw'ekitabo, ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kibeera mu katundu akasooka.
answer_d: Omutwe gw'ekigambo guddamu ekibuuzo “Ekiwandiiko kino kifa ku ki?” ate ekirowoozo ekikulu kigwa mu mugatte gw'ekyo ekigambiddwa ku mutwe ogwo.

question: Valentina ali mu kibiina kya PreK era akulakulanye mu bukugu bwe obw’okuwandiika, ng’asobola okugatta obutonnyeze okusiiga ennyiriri ez’enjawulo, n’okukuuma obutayosa mu makubo. Okusinziira ku mitendera gy’okutandika okuyiga okuwandiika, bukugu ki obuddako omuwala ono bw’asaanidde okutendeka, ng’assa ekitiibwa mu mutindo gw’obuzibu bwabyo?
answer_a: Koppa vawule mu ndaga eyawandiikidwa mu mukono ogwegattika.
answer_b: Balambulula ebifaananyi n'enkula ez'enjawulo.
answer_c: Loba empandiika ezitaliimu kifaananyi ekigendereke kyonna ez’obunene obw’enjawulo.
answer_d: Londa amakubo ng'ogoberera obutindo n'enzigotta.

question: Omusomesa agenda kutandika omutwe ogw'okusoma okutegeera ebitabo by'ekikomediya. Nga tannatandika, agenda kukola akeesso akamuyamba okumanya obumanyirivu bw'abayizi, era ekigendererwa ky'akeesso kano kwe: "Okutegeera ebintu ebikulu ebigendererwa mu bitabo by'ekikomediya." Kiki ekikulu ekyetaagisa okuba mu kkeesso lino?
answer_a: Ebyafaayo by'emizannyo egy'ekivulu
answer_b: Enkola ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru ey’emizannyo gy’ekigambo
answer_c: Enjawulo enkulu wakati w'emizannyo egy'ekiseko n'emizannyo egy'ennaku
answer_d: Enkola z’okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko eby’obuwangwa

question: Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসરૂম muno wammanga: Mu ক্লাস ze eziddako, omusomesa w’olungereza alina okusomesa akabonero kano ak’okuyiga: “Okuddamu okwogera ebiri mu kiwandiiko mu ngeri энжавуло.” Akabonero kano ak’okuyiga kakwatagana na kirubirirwa ky’okuyiga ki ku bino ebiddako?
answer_a: Londa ebigambo ebimu ebiri mu muwandiiko
answer_b: Fumiitiriza okuva mu biwandiiko okumanya ebintu ebikulu oba ebitono ebikulu ebiwandiikiddwa.
answer_c: Laga ekirowoozo ekikulu mu mawulire agawandiike obuwandiike obugazi oba obutongole.
answer_d: Laga okutegeera amawulire agawandiike obuntuntunu oba agawandiike mu bujjuvu.

question:
Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসিকroom eno wammanga:
Omusomesa w’olungereza asabye abayizi be okusoma ebiwandiiko mu bwangu ate oluvannyuma okuddamu ekibuuzo kino: “Ekirowoozo ekikulu mu biwandiiko kye ki?” Mu nkola z’okusoma zino wammanga, musomesa alina nkaayiira ki gy’asaba abayizi be okukozesa?
answer_a: Okukenenula
answer_b: Okutemera
answer_c: Okusoma okw'obwegendereza
answer_d: Okusoma okw'amaanyi

question:
Soma embeera y’omu ক্লাসিকুমু eno:
Mme. Parada, omusomesa w’Olungereza, abadde akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku ngeri y’okukwatamu ebigambo eby’enjawulo n’ebigambo ebikwata ku bikolwa bya bulijjo okumala wiiki bbiri eziyise okusobola okubaleetera okubyogera mu kamwa. Leero awuliriza lipooti z’abayizi ze boogera ku “Ebikolwa byabwe ebya bulijjo”. Wadde nga Mme. Parada akimanyi nti abayizi bangi bakoze ensobi mu mpandiika y’ebigambo mu kiseera kye babadde boogera, tabalongoosa era abaleka ne bagenda mu maaso n’ebyogerwa byabwe.
Okusinziira ku mbeera y’omu ক্লাসিকুমু egambiddwa waggulu, kiki ku bino wammanga ekiyinza okuba ensonga esinga obulungi okuwagira endowooza y’omusomesa ono?
answer_a: Omusomesa atwala ensobi ng’ekitundu ku ngeri y’okuyiga.
answer_b: Omusomesa awagira endowooza nti ensobi za bulijjo era teziyinzika kwewalika.
answer_c: Omusomesa alowooza nti okukolola kiyinza okuleetawo obutategeeragana mu bayizi be.
answer_d: Omusomesa alowooza nti abayizi balina okwogera ku mutwe gw'ekigambo, kale obutuufu si kye kisinga obukulu.

question: Ssinga otunuulira embeera eri mu ssomero eno: Emu ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga olungereza mu kibiina eky’ekkumi n’ekimu kwe "kwogera omuntu ky’alowooza nga akozesa obwogezi obumala eddakiika nga ssatu n’emboozi ennyimpimpi nga mulimu okukyusa ebirowoozo emirundi nga kkumi na mukaaga nga mw’otadde n’emikolo gy’emyaka egiyise n’omukolo gw’okutegeeza ekyo abalala kye boogedde, ng’olaga ekigendererwa". Bwe baba bakebera obuwanguzi bw’ekigendererwa kino, abayizi mu mutendera guno basabwa kwanjula emboozi mu bubinja obw’abantu bana nga balina okukozesa ebigambo ebimu ebiweereddwa, n’enjogera era nga balina ekigendererwa ekimu. Buli bbinja lwe limaliriza okwanjula emboozi yaabwe, Mwami Fuentes, omusomesa waabwe ow’olungereza, ayimiriza emboozi okukola obulongoofu ku nsobi z’ebbalangulo oba enjatula abayizi ze bakoze. Okusinziira ku ndagiriro ezikwatagana n’okukebera eziragiddwa ku programu y’okusoma ey’omutendera guno, lwaki Mwami Fuentes aba takwatagana nazo?
answer_a: Olwokubanga enzirukanya z'ebigendererwa by'okuyiga ez'omulembe guno ziraga nti okwogera kulungi okukulaakulana mu mbeera ey'obuteefu.
answer_b: Olw’okuba okusalako omuyizi ebigambo ng’akyayogera okumukolako obubi ku ngeri gy’alimu okwogera.
answer_c: Okuva abayizi abava ebweru be bakola ensobi mu bigambo bye boogera era nga tebasobola kuziggwayo ddala.
answer_d: Olwokubanga okukola ensobi kitundu ku buli mukutu ogw'okuyiga era abayizi balina okuweebwa omukisa okwogera kyebalowooza nga tebatya.

question: Omusomesa mu somo erikwata ku nzirukanya y'ennimi awa abayizi be omutwe gw'amawulire guno: Ndi mukakafu nti Cristiano Ronaldo agenda kuwummulira mu Madrid. Kika ki kya kigambo ekiri wansi ekirina okukimanyibwa abayizi mu mutwe gw'amawulire oguli waggulu?
answer_a: Ekigerekera ekikola ekintu
answer_b: Ekigambo ekiggumiza erinnya
answer_c: Ekigattiro ekiggumiza embeera
answer_d: Ekigambo ekiggattiddwa ku kigambululo ekiraga obudde, ekifo, oba engeri.

question: Mu kitundu ky’ennyimba, omusomesa aleeta eri abayizi be oluyimba olulondoola: Mu nnaku ezo nnali emyaka amakumi abiri era nnali mulalu. Nnali mbuze eggwanga naye nga nfunye ekirooto. Era bwe nnali nina ekirooto ekyo ebisigala tebyali bya mugaso. Wadde okukola wadde okusaba wadde okusoma ku makya okumpi n’embwa ez’omukwano. Era ekirooto kyabeeranga mu bbanga ly’omwoyo gwange. Ekisenge eky’omuti, mu bisiikirize, mu kimu ku mawuggwe g’obutonde bw’ensi. Era oluusi nnakyukanga munda yange ne nkyalira ekirooto: ekibumbe eky’olubeerera mu birowoozo ebikulukuta, envunza enjeru eyeewetamu mu kwagala. Okwagala okutaliiko kifaananyi. Ekirooto munda mu kirooto ekirala. Era ekirooto ekibi kyambuulira: ojja kukula. Ojja kuleka emabega ebifaananyi eby’obulumi n’ekkubo erizibu era ojja kwerabira. Naye mu nnaku ezo okukula kwandibadde musango. Ndi wano, nnagamba, n’embwa ez’omukwano era wano nja kusigala. Embwa ez’omukwano, Roberto Bolaño. Kiki ekireetera omuyimbi okuyimba abayizi kye balina okutegeera mu luyimba oluyimbiddwa waggulu?
answer_a: Omukwano omutaliimu bwagezi ogw'omuwandiisi w'ebitontome
answer_b: Obutaba na mizizi bw'omuwandiisi w'ebitontome
answer_c: Ekirooto ky'omuvubi omuto
answer_d: Emikwano gy'omuvubi omuvubuka

question: Soma embeera eno wammanga: Omusomesa w’ekibiina eky’okubiri aleeta ebiwandiiko bino eri abayizi be okukola ku kutegeera byebasoma: "Waaliwo ekifo ekipppe era eky’ekizikiza. Akawungeezi ak’obunafu kaali kayingidde mu bisenge, era ebiyitiro ebiwanvu byaleetanga eddoboozi ly’ebigere byonna okudda nga teggwaawo." Oluvannyuma lw’okusoma, abayizi abasinga obungi tebaasobola kunnyonnyola kifo ekyo mu bigambo byabwe. Lwaki ebiwandiiko ebyo waggulu tebisaanira kukozesebwa kukola ku kutegeera ebiwandiiko n’abayizi b’ekibiina eky’okubiri?
answer_a: Lwakuba kirimu sentensi ezirina omuko gwazo ogutegeerekeka obutegeerekeka.
answer_b: Kubanga kirimu obunyiriri obutali bukulu.
answer_c: Olwekubanga mulimu ebigambo ebizibu.
answer_d: Kubanga bwe bunnyonnyofu bw’ekifo ekitayogerwako mannya.

question: Soma embeera eno: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okuna asaba abayizi okuleeta ebyokulabirako by’enfuumo okuva awaka. Ekklaasi bw’etandika, annyonnyola nti enfumo bububonero obumpi obusobola okukozesa oluyimba era obukiikirira ekitundu ku magezi agaliwo oba amagezi agabantu bonna. Abayizi baleeta enfumo ze baleese, nga muno mulimu: "Embuzi eweereddwa tekebera mannyo", "Mu nnyumba y’omuweesi, akambe k’omuti", era "Akanyonyi akali mu mukono kasinga ebikumi ebiwanuka." Oluvannyuma, mu bibiri bibiri, abayizi bakola kaadi z’enfumo ze baleese okuva awaka, banyumya ku makulu ga buli emu, era oluvannyuma, buli kibiri kinnyonnyola enfumo zaabwe eri ekklaasi. Kintu ki ku kusoma omusomesa ky’asinga okukwatako mu mulimu guno?
answer_a: Okunnyonnyola engeri ennimi ez'ekifaananyi gye zikozesebwa
answer_b: Omukwano wakati w'ekiwandiiko n'obulamu obwa bulijjo
answer_c: Okwekenneenya embeera ezivaamu engero
answer_d: Okutegeera ebikolebwa eby'omuwendo ennyo mu nnono y'abantu

question: Lowooza ku mbeera eno: Omusomesa atandika n'ekibiina kye eky'abaana abato akadde ak'okusoma olugero olwa bulijjo, era ku lw'ekyo awandiika ku lubaawo erinnya ly'olugero lwe bagenda okusoma: "Ekkungulu erisirusiru". Oluvannyuma, abasoomooza okunoonya olugero lwe bagenda okusoma. Josefina agolola omukono gwe waggulu n'agamba: "Ndisobola okukikola," era mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka atandika okusoma mpola, ng'addamu okusoma emirundi ebiri, okutuusa lw'agamba nti: "Tugenda kusoma Ekkungulu Erisirusiru." Josefina ali mu mutendera gwaki ogw'enkola y'okusoma?
answer_a: Ekyapaango ky'ennukuta
answer_b: Nga tannaba kuwandiika bigambo mu nkula yabyo
answer_c: Olunnukuta
answer_d: Ennyingo z'ebigambo

question: Omusomesa atunuulidde omuwala mu ssomero ly'abaana abato, bw'abadde awandiika erinnya lye, aliwandiise mu ngeri ekyamu, nga bwe kiragiddwa mu kifaananyi kino: Nga tutunuulidde engeri omuwala gy'awandiiseemu, kiti kiki ekyetaaga okukolebwako naye okuyamba okuyiga kwe?
answer_a: Okulaba n'okutegeera ebintu
answer_b: Obukugu bw’omubiri obw’ekimu okuliko omulala
answer_c: Okutegeera obusangiro
answer_d: Entabaganya y'amaaso n'ebikolwa

question: Mu kibiina eky’omukaaga, omusomesa w’Olulimi n’Empuliziganya agenda kutandika omutwe guno: "Okuwandiika obutuufu, nga tukozesa amateeka g’akabonero akawunzifu." Kiki abayizi kye balina okumanya okusobola okutegeera akabonero akawunzifu?
answer_a: Omulamwa gw'ekiwummulo
answer_b: Omulamwa gw'akazannyo k'amaloboozi
answer_c: Okutegeera ebigambo eby'akawango kamu
answer_d: Okutegeera ebigambo ebifaanagana mu nnyingo

question: Mu kibiina ky'olulimi, okukozesa omulamwa gw'obubaka obw'ekikungo (propaganda), omusomesa asaba abayizi okukola kampeyini ekubiriza okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi munda mu ssomero. Ku lw'ekyo, emirimu egy'enjawulo gissibwawo, gamba ng'okutegeera embeera y'essomero ku by'okufaayo ku butonde bw'ensi, okuteekateeka ebiruubirirwa bya kampeyini, okubaga omukutu ogw'obuwangwaazi, n'okunoonya ebikozesebwa eby'obukugu okutambuza omulimu guno. Okukekkereza okutuukirizibwa kw'ekitundu ekisooka ekya kampeyini, omusomesa awa buli kibinja olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola (checklist) basobole okwekebera bokka. Lwaki kisaanira okukozesa olukalala lw'ebyo bye balina okukola mu kitundu kino ekisooka ekya kampeyini?
answer_a: Kubanga buli muyizi asobola okumanya engeri gy’akolamu mu mirimu gye gimuwebwa.
answer_b: Olw’okuba abayizi bajja kusobola okwawula ebikorwa bye bamaze okukola mu biti.
answer_c: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okwekenneenya mu bujjuvu buli kimu ku bikolwa bye bakoze.
answer_d: Kubanga abayizi bajja kusobola okukakasa oba bamalirizza emirimu egibadde gibakwasiddwa egyekuusa ku kampeyini.

question: Abayizi abali mu mwaka ogw'omusanvu bakola ku nkola entongole ey'empapula z'amawulire, era olw'ensonga eno, omusomesa abasabye okufulumya ebiwandiiko by'amawulire. Kiki ku bintu ebikozesebwa okukebera ebiri wammanga ekisinga okuba ekituufu okukakasa obanga ebintu ebikola empapula z'amawulire birabika mu biwandiiko ebyafulumiziddwa?
answer_a: Omutindo gw'okusiima
answer_b: Olukalala lw'eby'okukakasa
answer_c: Ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku mbeera y'omuyizi.
answer_d: Ekyokulabirako ekikulembera

question: Soma embeera eno: Mu kibiina ekisoma okunnyonnyola ebiwandiiko ebirimu okukaayana mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, ng’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga kiri ‘Kutegeera endowooza y’omuwandiisi, ensonga ze n’engeri gy’akozesaamu obukodyo bw’okuwandiika obulungi’, omusomesa ateekwa abayizi okusoma n’okugeraageranya ebbaluwa eri omukulu w’amawulire ezikwata ku nsonga y’emu. Ku biragiro by’okukebera ebiteereddwa wammanga, kiruwa ekikwatagana n’ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyateereddwawo mu kibiina?
answer_a: Londa omulamwa omukulu ogw'ebiwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'otunuulira enkozesa y'ebigambo n'engeri ebigambo bwe bitegekeddwa.
answer_b: Gerageranya engeri emiramwa gy’emyawulo egyolekeddwamu mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo okusinziira ku ngeri ebirowoozo gye bitegekeddwamu n’engeri ebigambo gye bikozesebwamu.
answer_c: Kola endowooza yo ku nsonga eyanjuddwa mu biwandiiko eby'enjawulo, ng'okozesa ebikozesebwa eby'obumu n'obwegattiro.
answer_d: Wawula amakulu ag'omutwe, ng'osinziira ku by'obuwangwa ebikozeseddwa, okutegeera ekigendererwa ky'omuwandiiko.

question:
Omusomesa akola n'abayizi be ab'ekibiina ekyokusatu ku kutegeera ebyo basoma okusinziira ku lugero "Empungu Eyekka." Wammanga waliwo ekitundu ekiggyiddwa mu mwoleso guno:
Edda nnyo, kyategekebwa nti ebinyonyi byonna eby'oku lusozi oluli okumpi n'ennyanja birina okufumbiriganwa. Okutuukiriza ekyo, ebirango byateekebwawo buli we waali osobola okusobozesa ebinyonyi okukung'aana ku mukolo. Waali wasigaddeewo obutikitiki butono okutandika omukolo era ebinyonyi byonna byali birindirira nnyo akadde ako, naye empungu yali terina gw'efumbirwa. Nga anakuwadde, yagenda. Embaga zaakolebwa; ebinyonyi byajaganya, newankubadde tebyeerabira nnaku y'empungu.
Omu ku bayizi be abuuza omusomesa: "Okunakuwala" kitegeeza ki?
Kino ku bino wammanga kiki ekiyinza okuyamba omuyizi okutegeera amakulu g'ekigambo kino ng'ayita mu kumanya akatundu akasooka ak'ekigambo?
answer_a: Noonya ekigambo ekiri mu lusuku lw'ebigambo lwe lumu n'ekyo ekiri mu mutwe gw'ekibuuzo era olukwataganye ebigambo byombi n'obubonero obuli mu mutwe gw'ekibuuzo obusobozesa okutegeera amakulu gaakyo.
answer_b: Noonya ebigambo ebirala mu mutango ebiri n'ebinyigirizi, bisimbewo era obikwataganye okuzuula kiki ebigambo bino kye bifaanagana.
answer_c: Noonya ebigambo ebifaanaanyiriza empungu mu mutanda, bisimbeko olukoloboze era obigatte n'ekigambo ky'oyagala okuzuula amakulu gaakyo.
answer_d: Noonya ekikolwa ekyeyongera ku kigambo ky’oyagala okuzuula amakulu gaakyo era okwataganye ebigambo bino ebibiri n’ebigambo ebiri okumpi mu mutexti.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekika kya ‘kindergarten’ akola omulimu gw’okwanjula ng’ayita mu baana, ku kitundu kya Chile; ng’ayita mu nkola eno, akungaanya obukakafu ku busobozi bw’abaana “okwogera mu lulimi ku nsonga ze baagala, nga bakozesa ebigambo eby’enjawulo era nga bateekamu ebigambo ebipya era ebikwatagana n’embeera ez’enjawulo ez’okwogera n’aboogerezeganya.” Sofía ayanjula ekitundu kya La Araucanía era n’alaga nti mulimu endiga era nga zimanyiddwa okubeera n’emikwano gyazo. Nga tutunuulidde embeera eyo waggulu, kwe kulonda ki omusomesa kw’anaakola okuyamba Sofía okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’okuyiga ekyayogerwako?
answer_a: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, ogabanye amawulire ag'omugaso ku by'e La Araucanía. Biki ebirala bye wayize ku ndiga?
answer_b: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, amawulire g'otuwadde gatuyigirizza bingi. Omanyi endiga kye zeeyagalira okukola ne mikwano gyaazo?
answer_c: Weebale nnyo, Sofiya, amawulire g'otuwadde gansanyusizza nnyo. Omanyi nsolo ndala ziri mu La Araucanía, okuggyako endiga?
answer_d: Weebale nnyo, Sofía, ogabanye obubaka obukulu obukwata ku La Araucanía. Omanyi ekibiina ky'endiga kiyitibwa kitya? Ebisibo biba bisobola okuba eby'embuzi era.

question: Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekikwatagana n’omuwala oba omulenzi ali ku mutendera gwa “syllabic-alphabetic” mu kuwandiika?
answer_a: Okukoppa amannya gaabwe
answer_b: Awandiika ebigambo ebyangu.
answer_c: Awandiika ennukuta ze bamanyi buli emu gyokka.
answer_d: Akoppoola ebigambo ebitono okusobola okubuulira abalala ekintu.

question: Ekitongole ekikuumira ebikozesebwa mu kusomesa mu ssomero kirina ebintu eby’enjawulo eby’okusomesa ebigendereddwa okukulaakulanya olulimi. Omusomesa w’abaana abato alina okulonda ekintu ky’ayagala okukozesa okusomesa abayizi be ku kumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi. Okusinziira ku mbeera eyo waggulu, kiki ekisinga okuba ekyetaagisa okukozesebwa butereevu okukulaakulanya okumanya amateeka agafuga olulimi?
answer_a: Empapula eziriko ebigambo ebitegeeza ebitali bimu
answer_b: Domino y'eddoboozi ly'ennukuta entandisi
answer_c: Kaadi z’okulambika ebifaananyi n’ebigambo
answer_d: Kaadi z’okuzimbisa sentensi nga tukozesa obubonero bw’ebifaananyi.

question:
Mu katabo, omuntu asobola okulaba obutali bwadde eri abantu abasinga, naddala omuntu omukulu, okukola kyebaagala oba okweyisa nga bwe baagala. Ng’ekyokulabirako, mu kifo ekimu omuntu ayogera ku byafaayo agamba nti tewali n’omu asobola kuwasa gw’ayagala kubanga bwe bakwatibwa basobola okusibwa oba okuttibwa. Kino kindabika bubi nnyo kubanga omuntu tasobola kuba muddeeri okubeera n’omuntu gw’ayagala era, oluusi, mu nnaku zino, kino kisobola okulabika, ng’ekyokulabirako, abantu bwe bakakibwa oba okwekaka okubeera n’omuntu olw’obwangu oba olw’okweraga oba ssente so si lwa kwagala.
Ku bino ebiteekateeka ebisobola okuva eri omusomesa ku ky’omuwandiisi, kiki ku bino ekiyinza okuba eky’amugaso ku nkozesa y’ebikwata ku biwandiiko?
answer_a: Bw’otooteekemu biwandiiko eby’okukakasa, endowooza zo zijja kuggwaamu obutuufu.
answer_b: Yongera ku kamunnyeenye ako n’ensonga endala ey’ekizibu era ogiwagire n’ekigambo ekiggiddwa mu katabo.
answer_c: Singa mu kifo ky’okwogera ku katabo, onoonnyonnyola ekitundu ky’ekiwandiiko ky’oyagala okwogerako, kyandibadde kyeyolefu.
answer_d: Ddamu osome omulongoosa ogunnyonnyola ebyo ebinukuta ebyoleka bye bikola era otunule nnyo ku byokulabirako ebiragiddwa.

question: Omusomesa wa kkindagateni yeetaaga okukola okukebera okuzuula obukugu bw'abaana mu bigambo, naddala obusobozi bwabwe okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo n'okutegeera ekibinja kye birimu. Mbeera ki ey'omusomo esaanira okukungaanya obukakafu obukwata ku bukugu buno?
answer_a: Baaleete abaana okuzannya emizannyo gy'okubuzaabuza. Ebirungo ebikulu eby'ebigambo eby'enjawulo bigenda kwogerwa, nga tetukozesezza bikozesebwa okulaba. Kozesa olukalala okukweka ebyo ebituukiddwaako.
answer_b: Leeta abaana ebintu eby’enjawulo n’ebisero ebikiikirira ebibinja eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu ku bintu ebyo, okwogera erinnya lyakyo, n’okukissa mu kibinja. Pima engeri gye bakozesezzaamu olubimbi.
answer_c: Baaleete abaana okwetegereza akataabaliro akalimu ebibinja eby’enjawulo, era obawa kaadi ze balina okukwataganya n’ekibinja ekikwatagana nazo. Kozesa empapula z’ebyo abanaakoze okukweka engeri gye bakolamu.
answer_d: Bawe abaana empapula erimu ebifaananyi by’ebika by’ebintu eby’enjawulo, obasabe okulonda ekimu bakinyonnyole nga tekyogedde linnya lyakyo. Bannaabwe balina okwogera ekigambo ekyo n’okwogera ekika kyakyo. Kebera engeri gye bakozesezzaamu ebipimo.

question: Omusomesa w’abaana abali mu myaka egya wakati akiraze nti ekibiina kye eky’abalenzi n’abawala banyumirwa nnyo ebintu ebibaleka nga beeyambisa emikono gyabwe okuyiiya n’okunoonya, era emirundi mingi bakoppa ennukuta okuva mu ngero, magazini, n’obubonero. N’olwekyo, ku ntandikwa ya semista ey’okubiri, ategese okukola ku bigendererwa by’okuyiga bino wammanga: - Omusingi gw’Olulimi Olwogereke: “Okufulumya obubonero bwabwe obw’okuwandiika mu mbeera ez’omuzannyo.” - Omusingi gw’Omubiri n’Entambula: “Okulongoosa enkolagana wakati w’amaaso n’emikono nga bayita mu kukozesa ebintu, ebizannyisibwa, n’ebikozesebwa eby’enjawulo.” Kiki ekireetawo okuyiga okutumbula ebigendererwa ebyateekebwawo omusomesa?
answer_a: Mu kibinja ekinene, mukole omulimu gw'okusoma ebitontome; oluvannyuma, abaana bakoppe ebigambo ebimu nga bwe beetondeera obubaka bwabwe.
answer_b: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana basabiddwa okusalako ebigambo okuva mu magazini n'empapula z'amawulire, ate oluvannyuma okukoppa ebimu ku byo nga bakola ebiwandiiko ebipya.
answer_c: Mu bubinja obutono, abaana bakubirizibwa okuwandiika awamu ekifo ky’emmere, oluvannyuma bafumbe nga bakozesa ebijiko, enfuuwe, n’ebbakuli okukola omugatte.
answer_d: Mu kibinja ekinene, somesa olugero mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka ate oluvannyuma oyite abaana okusiiga ebifaananyi by'ekibaawo eky'omugongo oba ebifo eby'enjawulo okuva mu lugero nga banoonyereza amannya g'abazannyi.

question: Omusomesa ow’ekibiina eky’okusatu agenda kukola omulimu gw’okuwandiika olugero n’abayizi be, ng’asinga kwetikka ku ngeri y’okukyusaamu okutambulira awamu n’embeera y’okwogera. Nga twejjukanya ku ky’omusingi kino eky’omulimu guno, mu bibuuzo bino omusomesa by’abuuza, kibuuzo ki ekisaanidde okusinga abayizi okutandika okuteekateeka engeri gye bagenda okuwandiikaamu ebyo bye baagala okuwandiika?
answer_a: Olugero lwaffe luliba lwa kitya?
answer_b: Tugenda kuwandiikira ani olugero lwaffe?
answer_c: Olugero lwaffe lugenda kusiimattuka wa?
answer_d: Lulimi ki lwe tugenda okukozesa mu lugero lwaffe?

question: Mu ssomero lya P7, mu kiseera kye bayiga ku Nfumo n'Engeri Ensi bwe yatondebwa, omusomesa akola ku kigendererwa kino: "Okwekenneenya omulimu gw'abantu abakulu mu nfumo z'okutonda." Okutuukiriza kino, alonzeemu emboozi ezakolebwa obuwangwa obwenjawulo. Ku bikolwa bino wammanga, kiki ekisaanira abayizi okukola okusobola okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kino?
answer_a:
**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo enkulu**

*   **Zeusi:** Katonda omukulu mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Hera:** Mukyala wa Zeusi era kabona omukulu mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Poseidoni:** Katonda w'ennyanja mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.
*   **Hadesi:** Katonda w'ensi embi mu baddayimooni Abagiriki.

**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo z'omu Misiri**

*   **Ra:** Katonda w'enjuba mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Isisi:** Kabona omukulu omukyala mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Osirisi:** Katonda w'abafu mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.
*   **Horusi:** Katonda w'eggulu mu baddayimooni Abamisiri.

**Eky'omu Kadde: Ensolo z'omu Norse**

*   **Odini:** Katonda omukulu mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Tori:** Katonda w'enkuba n'okubwatuka mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Loki:** Katonda omulimba mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
*   **Freyja:** Kabona omukulu omukyala w'obugagga n'omukwano mu baddayimooni Abanorsi.
answer_b: Leeta ebifaananyi ebyawula abazannyi abakulu, abaddako n’abatagasa nnyo mu ngero ze tulonze.
answer_c: Teeka mu mmeeza nga olaga engeri abamu ku bantu abali mu ngero ezo gye bakwatagana n’ebintu ebyogerwako mu ngero ezo.
answer_d: Wandiika obuwandiike obumpi mwe bannyonnyola empisa z'abantu abakulu abali mu ng'ano ze mwalonze.

question: Omusomesa akola ku nsonga z'obubonero bw'empandiika n'abayizi be aba 7. Okukola kino, agaba akatabo akalimu dduyiro eno: Soma ekitundu ekiddiring'ana era oteeke akakomera, wekisaanidde, mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi. Sergio Gómez muwandiisi w'empagi, omukulu w'abawandiisi, omusomesa w'Oluyisipaniya, era omuwandiisi Omu-Chile eyeeyunira obuganzi bwe nnyo ku bitabo by'abato by'awandiise, naddala eby'omuseries wa dayirekita omuvubuka Quique Hache. Abayizi bamaliriza omulimu mu ngeri entuufu nga bateeka akakomera mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi oluvannyuma lw'ebigambo: muwandiisi w'empagi era omukulu w'abawandiisi. Kutegeera ki abayizi kwe balina okusooka okuyiga okusobola okuteeka akakomera mu kitundu ekisimbiddwa olukoloboze wansi mu ngeri entuufu?
answer_a: Tegeera ebintu ebirina engeri y’emu mu nnyingo.
answer_b: Londa obutundu obuwerekereza amannya.
answer_c: Londa ekigambo ekiri mu kiyita mu sentensi.
answer_d: Njawulo ki eriwo wakati w'ebigattabigambo ebikozesebwa okugatta ebirowoozo mu sentensi?

Abayizi ab'enjawulo boogera nti ekitontome tekitegeerekeka kubanga kizzaamu era ennyiriri tezikwatagana.

Nga tutunuulidde ebyo abayizi bye boogedde, kibuuzo ki omusomesa ky'ayinza okubuuza okubalagirira okutegeera ekitontome mu ngeri entuufu?
answer_a: Okuddamu-ddamu okwo n’ekirala ekirabika ng’ekitaliimu makulu kikwatagana kitya n’omutwe gw’omuzimu ogwo?
answer_b: Biki ebikozesebwa mu ngeri y'obuwandiisi ebiri mu kitontome ebitusobozesa okuddamu okutegeera amakulu g'emirongo?
answer_c: Omwogezi mu nnyimba ayagala okulaga ki ng'ayita mu bifaananyi eby'ekirooto by'azimba?
answer_d: Erinnya ly'ekifaananyi ky'ebyogero ekikozesebwa okuddamu ekigambo kye kimu mu nnyiriri eziwerako eziddiring'ana kye ki?

question: Omusomesa, mu kibiina eky’omwaka ogw’okubiri mu siniya, agenda kukola okunoonyereza n’abayizi ku byafaayo by’ebitabo eby’Omulembe Ogwa Zaabu, ng’asingira ku mpisa n’embeera y’ebyafaayo ey’ekiseera ekyo. Oluvannyuma lw’okunoonyereza ku intaneeti, abayizi bagenda kuteeka awamu olukalala lw’ebitabo olugazi, ate oluvannyuma balonde ebiwandiiko ebisinga okuba ebituufu okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky’okunoonyereza. Ku mirimu gino wammanga omusomesa gy’ateese, gumu ku gyo gw’osanga nga gwe gusinga okuba omutuufu okulonda ebiwandiiko ebinoonyerezeddwako?
answer_a: Teekawo empandiika y'ebitabo ebyakozesebwa okunoonyereza era olondeko ekijja okukozesebwa.
answer_b: Sooka osome ebiwandiiko mu bujjuvu okusobola okutegeera ensonga enkulu, oluvannyuma weerabirire obukulu bw'amawulire ago okusinziira ku bigendererwa by'okunoonyereza.
answer_c: Kozesa enkola okumanya omutwe n'ekigendererwa ekikulu eky'obubaka obuli mu buli kitabo ky'oyambiddwa era oluvannyuma okukungaanya ebimanyiddwa okusinziira ku mitwe emito, okusinziira ku kigendererwa ky'okunoonyereza.
answer_d: Nkoonya ensumbi z’ebigambo nga oziggyamu eby’obuwangwa by’omu makkati era oluvannyuma okole entegeka z’ebifaananyi n’ebigambo ebiyambako mu kunoonyereza.

question: Omusomesa omukulu mu kibiina eky’okuna, mu kitundu ky’ebyafaayo ebipya, agenda mu maaso n’okuddamu okuyigiriza ku nkola z’ebyafaayo ebipya. Oluvannyuma lw’okunnyonnyola amakulu g’eddoboozi ennyingi mu byafaayo n’okuwa ebyokulabirako, akizuula nti abayizi abamu tebannategeera bulungi kye kitegeeza. Okwanguya okutegeera, asalawo okunnyonnyola ensonga eno ng’ayitira mu lugero. Lugero ki omusomesa lw’ayinza okukozesa okwanguya okutegeera eddoboozi ennyingi mu byafaayo?
answer_a: Ekibiina ky'abayimbi ekya ssomero kiyimba oluyimba lw'essomero ku mukolo gw'eggwanga.
answer_b: Omukwano ogumu gusisinkana oluvannyuma lw'oluwummula okugabana ebifaananyi byabwe n'ebyo bye bayitamu.
answer_c: Omuntu ali mu kisaawe era n'ayogera ku nneeyisa y'abaana abakilizaawo.
answer_d: Omufumbo gw’ebimuli bwe gugwa okuva ku bbalakoni ne gugwa ku mmotoka eyimiridde, abalabye boogera bye baalabye.

question: Omusomesa ow’omwaka ogwokusatu, mu kiseera ky’essomo ly’okukubaganya ebirowoozo mu lwatu, akola omulimu gw’okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku bikwaata ku kukozesa amaanyi mu ngeri entuufu. Mu mbeera eno, omuyizi omu awolereza eky’okukubiriza abantu obutasaasaanya maanyi. Omuyizi omulala awakanya endowooza eno, ng’alowooza nti kiyinza okuba ekizibu okusalawo obanga okukozesa amaanyi kusaasaanya oba tekwasaasaanya. Omusomesa asaba omuyizi eyasooka okuddamu okutegeeza endowooza ye. Nkola ki eyinza okuyamba omuyizi okuddamu okutegeeza endowooza ye mu ngeri entuufu mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo kuno?
answer_a: Okukozesa enkulukuta eziddiring'ana okutegeeza ku bintu ebijjawo olw'okwonoona amasannyalaze
answer_b: Okukozesa enkwaso ezigattika okwongera ku birowoozo ebikwata ku ngeri endala ezitaliimu bulungi ez’okukozesa amaanyi.
answer_c: Okukozesa enkulukuta ezannyonnyola okumanya amakulu amatuufu agakola okusaanyaawo amasannyalaze.
answer_d: Okukozesa ennyingo eziraga obuzibu okusobola okwawula mu buceerefu engeri ezitali zimu emannyo gisobola okusaanyizibwaamu.

question: Mu kibiina kya munaana, omusomesa asaba abayizi okusoma olugero olumpi oluyitibwa 'Olugero' olwa Wislawa Szymborska ate oluvannyuma bakole ebibuuzo ebiyamba okutegeera obulungi ebyo ebiri mu lugero. Abalenzi abamu abavubi baaggya eccupa okuva wansi mu nnyanja. Munda mu ccupa mwalimu olupapula, era ku lupapula kwaliko ebigambo bino: "Muyambe!, Ndi wano. Ennyanja ensumuludde ku kizinga etaliiwo bantu. Ndi ku lubalama era ndinda obuyambi. Mwanguyiriza! Ndi wano!" –Tewali lunaku. Kijja kuba nga kiyiseewo ebbanga ddene. Eccupa yandiba nga emaze ebbanga ddene nga etengejja – omulenzi omuvubi eyasooka bwe yagambye. –Era ekifo tekiragiddwa. Tekimanyiddwa wadde nnyanja ki – omulenzi omuvubi owookubiri bwe yagambye. –Si kya lubeerera wadde kya wala. Ekizinga 'Wano' kiri buli wantu – omulenzi omuvubi owookusatu bwe yagambye. Embeera yafuuka mbi, obusirise ne bubaawo. Amazima agawamu galina ekizibu ekyo. Mu bibuuzo bino ebyakolebwa abayizi, kibuuzo ki ekikulembera okutegeera amakulu g'olugero olusomeddwa?
answer_a: Ennyingo "Wano" buli wantu kitegeeza ki?
answer_b: Enkomerero y’olugero yandibadde etya singa obubaka bwali butegerekeka bulungi?
answer_c: Lwaki abavubi tebawulira bulungi n’ekiddamu ky’omusajja owookusatu?
answer_d: Singa wandisangyeewo eccupa erimu obubaka ng’obwo, wandikoze ki era lwaki?

question: Mu kibiina kya P5, omusomesa agenda kukebera okumanya kw'abayizi be ku nkola y'emizannyo. Okukola kino, akola enteekateeka z'ebintu eby'enjawulo ebigenda okumuyamba okunoonya obukakafu obulaga ebyo bye bayize. Mu bintu bino ebigenda okukeberwa, kiki ekiraga okutegeera obuzibu obubeera mu mizannyo?
answer_a: Wawulaana ebikolwa ebikolebwa abantu abakola omuzannyo.
answer_c: Laga ensonga eziviiriddeko omuzannyi omukulu n’omuzannyi omubi okukola bye bakola mu muzannyo.
answer_d: Laga engeri ebikolwa by'omuntu omukulu n'omulabe mu muzannyo gye bikwatagana n'ebyo bye bayitamu.

question: Omusomesa mu mwaka ogwokusatu ogw’ekisulo, akolera wamu n’abayizi be ku kiruubirirwa kino: "Okutegeera engeri z’okuwandiika emboozi." Okukola kino, annyonnyola empisa za buli ngeri, oluvannyuma aleeta ebyokulabirako era awa abayizi omukutu okusobola okutegeera engeri zino mu bitundu eby’enjawulo. Ekimu ku bitundu mu ngeri etali butereevu era nga ya lukusa kiri nga bwe kiri wammanga: "Charles yeewuunyizza obweru bw’enjala ze. Zaali njeru, nga ziwawaala ku ntikko, nga zikoleddwa bulungi okusinga amannyo g’endovu ag’e Dieppe, era nga ziringa almondi. Naye omukono gwali si mulungi, oboolyawo nga si mweru kumala, era nga gufaanana embalaasi mu nnyingo; era gwali muwanvu nnyo era nga tegwaliimu bukugu bw’emigongo ku nkula. Ekyali kirungi amaaso; newankubadde nga gaali ga kyenvu, gaalabika nga maddu olw’emyoyo gy’oku maaso, era ng’atunuulira mu butuufu n’obuvumu obw’ekimoomo." (Madame Bovary, Gustave Flaubert). Omu ku bayizi azzeemu nti ekitundu kirimu engeri etali butereevu kubanga waliwo omwogezi ow’okusatu. Nga tutunuulidde okuddamu kuno, bya bya muwendo ki ebikwata ku ngeri z’okuwandiika emboozi omusomesa by’alina okwogerako abayizi basobole okutegeera engeri etali butereevu era nga ya lukusa?
answer_a: Okutegeera engeri omutontomi gy’atunuuliramu ebiri mu lugero
answer_b: Okutegeera ebika by’abanoonyereza mu mboozi
answer_c: Enjawulo wakati w'eddoboozi ly'omunnyonnyozi n'ery'abantu abakola ebikolwa mu lugero
answer_d: Okumanya omuntu annyonnyola byafaayo gy’ayimiridde okutunulira ebyo by’annyonnyola.

question: Ku mirundi gy'okuyiga egiddirira, gumu ku gyo ogikulaakulanya okumanya amakulu g'ebigambo (semantic awareness) era lwaki?
answer_a: Okutondekawo sentensi n'olukalala lw'ebiseera kubanga bikiriza okutegeka ebigambo.
answer_b: Okukola okwawula n'okufaananya okw'omumwa kubanga bikusobozesa okuwa amakulu eri ebigambo
answer_c: Okukola dduyiro y’okuwaana n’okwawula ebigambo mu nsalango kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeera eddoboozi ly’ebigambo.
answer_d: Okukozesa emizannyo gy'ebiseera by'ebikolwa n'okunnyonnyola empisa z'abantu kubanga bikusobozesa okutegeka ebigambo.

question: Ku biragiro bino wammanga, kiki ekireetera omuyizi okukulaakulanya okumanya engeri y’okukozesaamu olulimi mu mbeera ez’enjawulo?
answer_a: Zuula obutali butuufu mu bigambo ebiri mu ngero ennyimpi.
answer_b: Kola engero ez'ebigambo ng'okozesa kaadi ez'ebifaananyi by'ebigambo.
answer_c: Ggwaamu ebyo ebiri mu bigambo eby'ebbugumu eby'ennono ez'enjawulo.
answer_d: Tegeka sentensi ennyangu mu ngeri endala ku eyo eteereddwaawo.
